name: @alastria/isbe-contracts
description: Repository of certified and audited smart contracts for use in the ISBE network

scripts.clean: npm run clean:cache && npm run clean:build && npm run clean:node_modules
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sol && npm run lint:ts
scripts.pre-commit: npm run prettier && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
scripts.slither:analysis: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.28  && solc-select use 0.8.28  && slither . --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:storageLayout: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.28  && solc-select use 0.8.28  && slither . --print variable-order --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:inheritance: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.28  && solc-select use 0.8.28  && slither . --print inheritance --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither:summary: docker run -t --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v "$(pwd)":"/home/ethsec/contracts" -w "/home/ethsec/contracts" -u 0:0 trailofbits/eth-security-toolbox /bin/sh -c "solc-select install 0.8.28  && solc-select use 0.8.28  && slither . --print human-summary --solc-remaps @=node_modules/@"
scripts.slither: npm run slither:summary && npm run slither:storageLayout && npm run slither:inheritance && npm run slither:analysis

author: ISBE
